note: The Phase 2 slots as drafted for the Phase 2 screen of 2026-09-17 (session 51). A draft: nothing here is in the ledger until a dated changes line with the operator’s word ("Phase 2 go" or a changed list) adds it; that line reads this file and folds each slot’s defaults into the ledger’s slot.

phase.title: Phase 2 — The general components, over declared sources
phase.note: The definition model first, then the sources, then the components; each with spec, settings, defaults, template options, renderer and a test from a saved document.

questions.question: The seed migration (Component Settings into the model).
questions.default: Applied on the operator’s "apply <id>" with the operator present, rehearsed first inside begin … rollback.

questions.question: The first catalogue of sources and its migration.
questions.default: The thirteen the draft names: series · season · standings · results · rounds · sessions · drivers · teams · posts · news · authors · releases · tracks; the migration on "apply <id>".

questions.question: The preset names per series shape.
questions.default: The fifteen standings and results shapes named as the site names them today, shown as a list at P2.2’s turn.

questions.question: TanStack Table as a dependency.
questions.default: Yes, at P2.3’s turn, the bundle delta quoted against the 80% alarm (the dry run stands at 66%); no other new dependency in Phase 2 (Recharts 3.8 and Leaflet are installed).

questions.question: The series tabs as one page with Tabs, or one page per tab.
questions.default: Decided at P3.4, where the series pages are rebuilt; P2.10 builds the component either way.

questions.question: The item set for Form.
questions.default: Five: text · textarea · select (from a list of values) · switch · choice.

questions.question: Comments.
questions.default: Deferred; listed as "on the word" and not built until replies are wanted.

slots.title: The component definition model
slots.scope: Attributes with a scope (application, component, report), typed editors (colour, icon, code-free text, select, link, boolean), named attribute groups, declared events, capability flags gating editor sections, slots as typed nesting points; Component Settings migrates into it; a compatibility layer for today's settings.
slots.defaults: A definition is a document per component type in a shared component, Component Definitions (rule 10: Utilization, History, a delete guard); today’s six Home specs, the heading and the calendar become definitions; the Property Editor’s Attributes tab reads a definition’s groups and editors; today’s Component Settings keys read through the model unchanged.
slots.acceptance: Today's three component settings read through the new model unchanged; a new attribute with a group and a colour editor renders in the Property Editor; test.

slots.title: Data Sources shared component and the Source picker
slots.scope: Sources: series, season, standings, results, rounds, sessions, drivers, teams, posts, news, authors, releases, tracks; a data profile discovered from a pasted sample; a Remote Server base URL per environment; pagination presets; caching with scheduled invalidation; a delete guard; the loader adopts append / merge / replace, steps and a run log; the Object Browser lists the same catalogue.
slots.defaults: The catalogue declared in code first (a source is a name, parameters and a reader), rows only for the operator’s additions (remote servers, profiles); the Source group as APEX draws it (Type · Location · the source’s parameters); the loader’s run log in the Debug trace’s phases; the Data workspace’s Object Browser.
slots.needsWord: the first catalogue list; the migration on 'apply <id>'
slots.acceptance: A component's Source picks standings · f1 · 2026 and the renderer reads it; the Data page shows the loader's runs in the new vocabulary; test.

slots.title: The data region with views
slots.scope: One region over a source with views table · cards · list · timeline · detail; row templates (content row, media list, timeline, avatar, badge) as column types; typed columns (text, number, gap, link, badge, position, percent graph, image); named presets for the fifteen standings and results shapes; Card slots Title, Subtitle, Body, Media, Badge and five action zones.
slots.defaults: View is a setting of one data region (your word of 2026-09-10), default table; the presets are definitions of P2.0 (a preset names its columns and view); the fifteen shapes ship as presets, not pages; a card’s slots map to a source’s fields in the Attributes tab.
slots.acceptance: f1 and MotoGP standings render from the same region with different presets; the same source flips to cards; test per preset.

slots.title: Saved views, sort options, URL filters
slots.scope: Users may sort, filter, hide columns, download CSV (TanStack Table on the word); saved views in four tiers with share links; a sort-options list for card views; a URL filter vocabulary.
slots.defaults: The URL vocabulary first (it serves Filters too), the client table second; saved views as rows of a shared component; CSV from the source, not the DOM.
slots.acceptance: Sort and CSV work on a served table; a saved view opens from its link; bundle delta quoted.

slots.title: Region rules and links
slots.scope: Row highlight rule (leader, podium, followed series); column link to a page or pattern; master-detail between two regions on a page.
slots.defaults: Highlight rules as conditions over a row; a column link names a page or a pattern as buttons do (P1.12 B2); master-detail through the events P2.0 declares.
slots.acceptance: A highlighted leader; a driver name linking to /drivers/[slug]; a season list filtering a results table; test.

slots.title: Filters as a layer
slots.scope: A decoupled Filters region attached to a data region by reference: facets from the source's columns, cascading (Depending On), chip preview separate from the value list, search within a facet, a size guardrail, batch apply, reset, facet count charts.
slots.defaults: A Filters region names its data region; facets are the source’s declared columns; the URL vocabulary of P2.3 carries the state.
slots.acceptance: The calendar's series filter and the news filter as instances; a cascading team → driver facet; test.

slots.title: The Conditions vocabulary
slots.scope: One typed Condition attribute on every component (item = value, request, current page, authenticated, race weekend, never…), replacing show rules; both readable for one release.
slots.defaults: Today’s seven show rules map one to one (always, race weekend, between weekends, signed in, signed out, phones, desktop) and gain Never, Item = Value, Request = Value and Current page in; the Condition editor sits where Show sits (the Rules group); the Debug trace names the condition that hid a region; the parser reads both for one release, then show goes.
slots.acceptance: Every show rule maps to a condition; a region with condition never does not render; test.

slots.title: Metric cards
slots.scope: Figures with labels and trend over standings brief, weekend facts, data counts.
slots.defaults: A card is one figure, label and trend from a source field; a row of cards is one region.
slots.acceptance: Leader and gap on a series hub; test.

slots.title: Countdown
slots.scope: Next session of a series or all; session name; local time.
slots.defaults: NextRaceCountdown’s renderer as the instance; venue-local and viewer-local both shown.
slots.acceptance: The driver page's Next out; test.

slots.title: Live band
slots.scope: Weekends under way; also-racing rows; the race-weekend fact for conditions.
slots.defaults: home.live’s renderer as the first instance; the race-weekend fact stays the one the conditions read.
slots.acceptance: Home's This weekend as an instance; test.

slots.title: Tabs
slots.scope: Region Display Selector: view single / scroll; remember last; icons; over regions or child pages.
slots.defaults: A Tabs region lists sibling regions; the remembered tab per browser; child pages when P3 has them.
slots.needsWord: series tabs as one page with Tabs or one page per tab (asked at P3.4)
slots.acceptance: Weekend Preview and Report as Tabs; test.

slots.title: Chart
slots.scope: Type, series, axes, legend; season trend, qualifying gaps, comparisons (Recharts).
slots.defaults: Recharts 3.8 as installed; the chart’s series are source fields; the season trend’s invariant holds (totals match the standings tab).
slots.acceptance: The points trajectory on a team page; test.

slots.title: Map and Map Backgrounds
slots.scope: Map Backgrounds as a shared component (one named basemap: tile URL, key in the environment, a dark tile pair); the Map region: layer, initial view, markers (Leaflet).
slots.defaults: Leaflet as installed; the key named, never stored in a row (rule 10); the dark pair follows the theme’s family.
slots.acceptance: The tracks map from a named background; the dark pair follows the theme; test.

slots.title: Embed
slots.scope: Video or allowed iframe; provider, ratio, consent.
slots.defaults: An allow-list of providers (rule 10); consent through the site’s consent state; no autoplay.
slots.acceptance: A highlights clip on a weekend; test.

slots.title: Weather
slots.scope: Open-Meteo by venue-local date; hourly or daily; sessions overlay.
slots.defaults: The existing weather reader as the source; venue-local dates, never UTC.
slots.acceptance: The weekend's weather strip; test.

slots.title: Circuit
slots.scope: The round's venue: map, facts, layout image where one exists.
slots.defaults: The tracks content as the source (the Madring fix of 1.0.97 holds); the map through P2.12.
slots.acceptance: Round 14 shows Madring (fixed in 1.0.97); test.

slots.title: Search: results and configurations
slots.scope: A Results region over named Search Configurations (one per content type: title, description, link, icon, query prefix), search-as-you-type with a minimum, lazy loading, empty and no-results messages.
slots.defaults: The site index as it is; configurations as a shared component; the Learn hub first.
slots.acceptance: The Learn hub's search as an instance over drivers, races and posts; test.

slots.title: Breadcrumb
slots.scope: From the page tree; show home; separator.
slots.defaults: The page tree from the pages’ paths; Create › Breadcrumb Region comes alive (P1.10); a deleted page leaves the breadcrumb (P1.12).
slots.acceptance: A series tab's breadcrumb; test.

slots.title: Form, field templates, lists of values
slots.scope: Items text, textarea, select (from a list of values, static or dynamic, cascading), switch, choice; Field templates as the label + input + help + inline error contract; validations inline or in a notification; a success step that sends an email (Resend) or a push.
slots.defaults: Five items; lists of values as a shared component; the Contact form as the first instance through the existing Resend wrapper; Create › Create Page Item comes alive (P1.4).
slots.acceptance: Contact as a Form; a validation shows inline; the success step mails; test.

slots.title: Comments
slots.scope: Threads and replies; order; sign-in prompt.
slots.defaults: Not built until the word; the slot stays listed.
slots.needsWord: only if replies are wanted (nothing has them today)
slots.acceptance: Deferred until the word.

slots.title: Clerk widget
slots.scope: Sign-in, sign-up, account profile as a region; appearance from the theme.
slots.defaults: Clerk’s components wrapped as one region kind with a mode setting; the theme’s tokens through Clerk’s appearance.
slots.acceptance: /sign-in as a composed page; test.

slots.title: Email Templates
slots.scope: Shared component: subject and body with placeholders, edited in the designer, sent through the existing Resend wrapper by contact, welcome, feedback, draft-ready.
slots.defaults: Placeholders as {name}; a preview with sample values; the four senders read their template by key with the code’s text as the fallback.
slots.acceptance: The welcome email renders from the row; test.

slots.title: Automations page
slots.scope: Data › Automations: GitHub Actions workflows and crons with last run, next run, Run now (dispatch), an execution log.
slots.defaults: Read through the GitHub API with the existing token, named not stored; Run now dispatches the loader; the log is the runs list.
slots.acceptance: Run now dispatches the loader; the run appears; browser run.

slots.title: Calendar settings and events
slots.scope: Series filter, mode and range as settings; events Date Selected, Event Selected, View Changed other regions react to.
slots.defaults: The calendar component gains its settings in the Attributes tab and declares its events through P2.0.
slots.acceptance: Clicking a weekend refreshes a sessions list beside the calendar; test.

slots.title: Home's six become instances
slots.scope: home.lead → data region (cards, one card); home.live → Live band; home.result, home.changed → data region presets; home.next → data region (cards); home.wire → data region (list); the home.* specs retired.
slots.defaults: Parity output (the served HTML compared before and after) pasted in the PR; you publish the Home revision; the home.* specs leave the catalogue in the same PR.
slots.acceptance: Home renders identically from general components; parity output.
